name: vix_regime_switch_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: India VIX transitions between regimes (low <13, normal 13-18, elevated 18-25, crisis >25) and the optimal intraday strategy differs by regime. In low-VIX regimes, mean-reversion strategies dominate (tight ranges, reliable VWAP pulls). In elevated-VIX regimes, momentum and breakout strategies outperform (wider ranges, directional moves). By detecting the current VIX regime and switching between a mean-reversion sub-strategy (low VIX) and a momentum sub-strategy (high VIX), we adaptively capture the regime-appropriate edge. The inefficiency exists because most traders use static strategies regardless of volatility regime, leaving regime-conditional alpha on the table.
mechanism: Market microstructure varies across volatility regimes. In low-vol regimes, mean-reversion dominates as market makers provide tight liquidity. In high-vol regimes, momentum persists as liquidity thins and stop-cascades amplify moves. Adapting the signal to the current regime captures the appropriate edge for prevailing conditions.

indicators.name: vix_regime
indicators.formula: 'low' if VIX < 13 else 'normal' if VIX < 18 else 'elevated' if VIX < 25 else 'crisis'

conditions: IF vix_regime == 'low' OR 'normal': close < BB_lower AND RSI_14 < 30 AND ADX_14 < 25 (mean reversion mode)
IF vix_regime == 'elevated': close > EMA_9 AND EMA_9 > EMA_21 AND ADX_14 > 25 (momentum mode)
IF vix_regime == 'low' OR 'normal': close > BB_upper AND RSI_14 > 70 AND ADX_14 < 25 (mean reversion mode)
IF vix_regime == 'elevated': close < EMA_9 AND EMA_9 < EMA_21 AND ADX_14 > 25 (momentum mode)

exit.signal_exit: if vix_regime changes during trade, exit and re-evaluate

filters.vix_filter: core of the strategy — VIX regime determines sub-strategy; crisis regime (VIX > 25) = no trading

weaknesses: VIX regime boundaries (13, 18, 25) are arbitrary and may not be optimal; the strategy is sensitive to these thresholds and may generate whipsaw signals near boundaries
Switching between mean-reversion and momentum sub-strategies mid-day (if VIX crosses a boundary) can cause confusion and partial signals from the prior regime
The combined strategy has more parameters (7+) than a single-regime strategy, increasing overfitting risk in backtesting
prior_art: Ang & Bekaert (2004) regime-switching models; Baele et al. (2019) VIX-based strategy timing. Indian VIX regime thresholds calibrated from Banerjee & Sarkar (2006) on India VIX behavior.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
